description: This file defines API route handlers for managing answers in a Q&A platform. It includes endpoints to list answers, create answers (optionally with AI-generated content via OpenAI), and list answers for a specific question. It relies on FastAPI, SQLAlchemy ORM, and an external openai_service.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's routing class used to define API endpoints.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: ORM model representing an answer in the database.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: ORM model representing a question in the database.

classes.name: User
classes.description: ORM model representing a user in the database.

classes.name: AnswerOut
classes.description: Schema for serializing answer data in responses.

classes.name: GenerateAnswerRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating or generating a new answer.

methods.name: list_answers(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves all answers, ordered by newest first.

methods.name: create_answer( payload: GenerateAnswerRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Optional[User] = Depends(lambda: None), )
methods.description: Creates a new answer, optionally using AI to generate content.

methods.name: list_answers_for_question(question_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves all answers associated with a specific question.
